_comment: BEST-IN-CLASS short-form craft law for VedicHour Reels/posts. Drop-in principles for the marketing agent. The creative loop must fill storyboardTemplate.slots before any paid render. Founder approval is mandatory (src/audit/approvals.ts). Budget envelope: ~$200/mo total marketing; video must not eat ad money (see budgetAllocation + src/render/budget.ts).
_editing: Edit freely. Prefer revising this file over prompt strings. When a principle conflicts with config/playbook.json, THIS file wins for visual/audio/storyboard craft; playbook.json wins for retention research claims. Brand claims still defer to src/brand.ts + config/banned-claims.json.
northStar: Calm Precision Astrology on video — a private timing instrument, not a temple screensaver and not a Canva-template horoscope. If a paused frame could belong to any astrology creator, reject and replan.

operatingModel.automation: Agent ideates → fills 12-shot storyboard → preflight → Remotion/ffmpeg template assemble (preferred) or fal.ai only for locked presenter/b-roll cells → audit → approvals queue.
operatingModel.founderRole: Approve or reject only. Never ask the founder to edit timelines, pick fonts, or regenerate backgrounds by hand.
operatingModel.killCondition: Anything that fails brand safety, uncanny-valley face checks, or the neverGenerate list never reaches approvals.

budgetAllocationUsdPerMonth.notes: Aligns with src/render/budget.ts weekly video cap (~$35/wk is the HARD render ceiling; monthly paid-video target stays ≤$35 so ads keep majority share). Prefer $0 ffmpeg/Remotion templates + free brand SVGs over regenerating cosmos every time.

visualSystem.name: Night Ritual Frame
visualSystem.mode: Ritual canvas only — never Paper/parchment on Reels. Match docs/design-system.md Night surfaces + amber brand mark.

colors.rendererGoldNote: Current ffmpeg drawtext/ASS gold is #D4AF37 (playbook kit). Prefer migrating overlays to site amber #D4A853; until then keep ONE gold per reel — never mix both.

gradientRecipe.base: radial: nebula/indigo lift at top → cosmos mid → space/#06060F bottom
gradientRecipe.accent: single soft amber glow, top-right third only, opacity ≤0.35
gradientRecipe.stars: sparse cream pinpoints; no twinkle spam; constellation lines only at edges
gradientRecipe.ornament: at most one thin gold timing-dial arc (partial circle), low opacity — reads as clock/sun, never as zodiac wheel
gradientRecipe.negativeSpace: center vertical band must stay dark and empty for type (faceless). Presenter: face in middle-third; type clears face.

display.use: Hook title only (0–2.7s). Never for karaoke captions or CTA.

caption.case: UPPERCASE for karaoke groups of 2–3 words; sentence case allowed for static beat cards
caption.outline: translucent black; on product screencaps use opaque navy CaptionBand (BorderStyle=3)

mono.use: FORBIDDEN on Reels except a single tiny time tick on a product UI screencap that already uses it. Never for hooks or VO captions.

hindiEnglish.spokenAndLipSync: ROMAN / Latin Hinglish only (creative-seeds register). Devanagari in dialogue breaks Veo mouth shapes.
hindiEnglish.onScreenCaptions: Default Latin. If a Hindi keyword must appear on screen (e.g. राहु काल as a title card), use a Noto Sans Devanagari ASS style, max 3 words, and keep karaoke Latin.
hindiEnglish.mixingRule: One script per text layer. Never stack Devanagari + Latin on the same baseline.
hindiEnglish.pronunciationAid: Sanskrit terms in Latin with brand.ts pronunciation available to TTS; do not phonetic-spell on screen unless the beat is educational.

motion.easing: ease-out-expo feel (fast in, soft settle) — cubic-bezier 0.22, 1, 0.36, 1
motion.kenBurns: supersampled ping-pong on stills; amplitude subtle; never dizzying zooms
motion.grade: navy/gold split-tone + highlight bloom + vignette + luma grain (src/loops/video.ts GRADE/BLOOM/GRAIN)
motion.progressBar: thin amber fill at y≈14 — signature, keep
motion.wordmark: VEDICHOUR amber, y≈120, persistent except when it collides with a presenter's forehead — then drop to y≈80 or hide for that shot only

required: story ends before branded end card
finishPass.loudness: dialogue-led; music bed −18 to −22 LUFS under VO; no clipping

defaultMix.rationale: Faceless = volume + $0–low cost + brand consistency. Presenter = trust, explainers, comment replies, and platform preference for a visible human layer.

usePresenterWhen: Explainer / skeptic-friendly / 'what we're not' (pillars of calm credibility)
First-time product walkthrough where a human points at the report
Series that needs a recurring recognizable face (brand memory)
useFacelessWhen: Daily timing education (18 horas, Rahu Kaal, muhurat windows)
Hook banks and A/B variants of a winning script
Pure product-proof reels (screencap of the 18-hour grid)
Budget-tight days — stay inside ffmpeg template + edge assets

recurringFaceProtocol.goal: One calm Indian/diaspora adult face the audience can recognize — without Uncanny Valley.
recurringFaceProtocol.preferredPath: REAL founder or hired creator filmed once (15–30 lock takes) → image-to-video / talking-head templates. Best consistency, lowest valley risk.

constraints: Lock ONE avatar ID + ONE wardrobe + ONE lighting recipe in config; never re-roll 'random professional'.
Image-to-video with the same reference still on every presenter shot (subject continuity law).
Medium close-up, eye-line to lens, soft key from window side, night/#080C18 void behind — no office stock.
Native in-shot voice only for presenter dialogue (Veo native). Never overdub a second TTS timbre on the same face.
Max 8s continuous talking-head per shot; cut to product/b-roll before micro-expressions drift.
Reject frames with: waxy skin, asymmetric blink, melting hairline, extra fingers, plastic smile, dead eyes, uncanny teeth.
aiAvatarPath.budgetNote: HeyGen ~$24/mo only if recurring 'explains' series earns its keep; otherwise Veo presenter shots inside existing fal budget.

never: Generate a new 'pretty face' per post
Deepfake a celebrity or known astrologer
White-default stock avatars for an India-first brand without explicit choice

presenter.note: Hook clears Instagram top chrome AND face crown; karaoke over chest, never mouth; CTA above ~1500 bottom chrome.

productScreencap.style: CaptionBand opaque navy box — page text must never leak beside captions

legibilityTests: Readable at arm's length on a phone in sunlight simulation (high contrast)
No caption overlaps report UI text

voiceLadder.presenterDialogue: Model-native lip-synced voice (free with Veo) — quality bar. One timbre for the whole reel.
voiceLadder.facelessOrConnectiveVo: Sarvam Bulbul v3 single approved male AD voice (~$0.01/reel) — see src/render/sarvam.ts.

elevenLabs.when: Optional upgrade for flagship faceless series IF Sarvam/CapCut still feel thin — Starter ~$5–22/mo.
elevenLabs.how: Clone or lock ONE Indian-English / Hinglish-capable voice; stability high, style low, no theatrical emotion.
elevenLabs.whenNot: Do not buy ElevenLabs and Sarvam and CapCut TTS in the same month. One paid VO stack.

forbidden: edge-tts en-IN-NeerjaNeural for ad reels (owner rejected as AI-sounding)
robotic CapCut default on presenter-led pieces

musicBeds.goal: Felt, not noticed. Editorial ambient — think late-night documentary underscore, not 'epic India pack #7'.
do: Commission or license 3–5 looping beds (30–60s) once; rotate for months
Sparse drone + soft tanpura/swar hint OR clean neo-classical piano; leave 2–4kHz open for VO
Prefer Artlist/Epidemic custom search ('ambient documentary dusk', 'soft tanpura drone') over 'mystical India' presets
Or generate ONE private bed with a music model, then never regenerate — treat as brand asset
dont: Untagged CapCut 'Indian Folk Happy' / 'Mystic Temple' spam
Sitar + tabla loops everyone recognizes from Reels templates
Trending audio that fights the VO (if used for reach, keep ≤15–20% and duck hard)
musicBeds.budget: ≤$8/mo amortized — buy a small pack once rather than monthly subscriptions when possible.

whatEightyPercentLookLike: Zodiac-wheel spin + 'Your week will be…' fear/luck language
Neon purple galaxy stock + all-caps Impact captions
Green-screen creator pointing at CapCut text
AI god/deity faces, om symbols, temple bells, 'manifest' overlays
Sun-sign listicles ('Leos this week…') with emoji fire
Doom hooks: curse, Sade Sati panic, Manglik scare
Fake chat screenshots and 'astrologer WhatsApp' skits
differentiateBy: Concrete decision moment in Hinglish ('kal 11 baje meeting rakhun ya 4 baje?') — never abstract 'cosmic timing'
Visual proof of the product: real 18-hour grid screencap, amber clearer vs dim heavier
Night ritual grade + Cormorant hook — looks like VedicHour site, not CapCut astrology
Calm contrarian: 'not another horoscope' / 'day is not one mood' — no fear
Numbers that are ours: 18 horas, 27 nakshatras — used as clarity, not jargon flex
First frame is a readable sentence OR a face mid-thought — never a logo sting
hookFrameRules: High-contrast cream/amber on space — no thin grey type
If presenter: mouth not mid-word gibberish; eyes to lens
If faceless: timing-dial or grid fragment already in frame, center clear for type
Test: mute + 1-second scrub — stranger gets the conflict

endCard.look: Still Night frame — wordmark, one line invitation, domain. Feels like the last page of a report, not a Super Bowl cutdown.
copyHierarchy: Optional whisper: Your Life, Decoded Hour by Hour.
Promo NEWUSER30 only if it already appeared earlier OR in caption — never shout a coupon as the hero of the end card

visual.background: space/cosmos gradient, no new generative art
visual.logo: brand concentric gold rings or wordmark — from /brand assets, never AI-redrawn
visual.motion: single soft fade-in; no fireworks, no zoom-punch, no 'SHOP NOW' sticker

conversionWithoutAdSmell: No countdown timers, no fake scarcity
No testimonial stars, no '10,000 users' claims
CTA already earned by showing the report mid-reel
Caption + bio carry UTM; end card stays clean

neverGenerate._comment: Hard reject at creative, preflight, and audit. Overlaps banned-claims.json + visual tropes.
visualTropes: Gods, deities, murti, haloed faces, third eyes
Temples, diya spam, incense smoke as main idea
Zodiac wheels, sun-sign glyphs as hero art
Palmistry hands, crystal balls, tarot spreads
Glowing Sanskrit wallpaper behind dense text
Cartoon chakras, aura outlines, energy beams
Uncanny AI faces, beauty-filter plastic skin
Fake UI with gibberish text (models inventing screens)
Competitor logos or WhatsApp-forward astrologer skits
Blood-moon disaster imagery, black magic aesthetics
copyTropes: lucky/unlucky, best/worst hour, guaranteed, curse, doom
Engine jargon in ads: Swiss Ephemeris, Lahiri, ayanamsa, vimshottari

storyboardTemplate._comment: MANDATORY. Agent fills every slot before any fal.ai / paid render. Slots may be marked skip:true with reason, but the plan must exist. Final assembled reel may collapse adjacent skips; planning stays 12-beat.

slots.intent: Stop the scroll in ≤1s with a concrete decision or calm contrarian.
Name the ordinary moment (meeting, message, launch) — no astrology yet.
Show why generic horoscopes fail this moment (1/12 planet, one mood all day).
Introduce VedicHour lens: clearer vs heavier windows / personal chart.
One crisp mechanism beat (18 horas / nakshatra / dasha chapter) in plain English.
slots.providerBias: ffmpeg_template | kling for one beauty shot max

slots.intent: REAL report UI — hour slots scrolling; clearer amber, heavier dim.
Tap one slot — plain-English 'what this window suits'.
Bridge back to the viewer's decision; presenter or calm title.
slots.must: Same face/wardrobe as S01 if presenter path.

slots.intent: Optional skeptic beat — reflection not certainty. Skip if duration tight.
Spoken/on-screen invite to free Kundli — still in story tone.
Branded hold: free Kundli + vedichour.com + optional tagline.
slots.must: No karaoke over end card; bodyEndSec before this slot.

slots.intent: Not a video frame — publish pack: IG caption, 3–5 hashtags, YT title, UTM path, compliance self-check.
slots.must: Pass banned-claims + brand.ts; Latin caption; link in bio points to utm().

storyboardTemplate.gate: Refuse render if any non-optional slot lacks onScreenText + visual + shotRole + seconds, or if no product proof slot (S06/S07) exists on a product-led reel.

templatesBeatOneOffs.thesis: Remotion or ffmpeg brand templates beat one-off fal.ai generations for consistency, cost, and founder-scale ops.
whyTemplatesWin: Pixel-identical grade, fonts, wordmark, progress bar, end card — brand memory compounds
Near-$0 marginal cost after the template exists; fal.ai bills per second per shot
Deterministic captions/safe zones — no random composition failures
Subject continuity: stills + Ken Burns + real screencaps don't re-cast faces
Auditability: same filtergraph every time; defects are fixable in code, not prompt roulette
Founder approval is comparing script + storyboard, not 40 slightly different nebulas
whenFalAiIsAllowed: Locked presenter cells with reference image (image-to-video)
At most one broll_hero beauty shot per reel
Never for end cards, typography cards, gradients, or logos

architecture.preferred: Remotion (or existing ffmpeg assemble.ts) owns: Night background, type, karaoke, wordmark, progress, end card, music ducking, grade.
architecture.generativeCells: Only shotRoles presenter / broll_hero / broll insert into template timeline as clips.
architecture.cache: Hash(prompt+ref+model+seed) → reuse clip across variants; never regenerate identical cells.

migrationPath: Codify current v3.1 ffmpeg look as Remotion <Composition> props (colors from visualSystem.colors)
Storyboard JSON → Remotion props + optional fal clip URLs
Keep assemble.ts as the production path until Remotion CI export matches grade parity

principles.principle: Reels live on the Night ritual canvas only — space/cosmos/amber, never parchment paper UI.
principles.detail: Paper canvas is for reading product surfaces. Video is a ritual frame: radial night gradient, sparse stars, one amber accent, Cormorant hook.

principles.principle: One amber/gold hex per finished reel.
principles.detail: Do not mix site #D4A853 and legacy renderer #D4AF37 in the same export. Pick one and drive ASS + drawtext + progress bar from it.
principles.source: design-system amber token vs src/loops/video.ts drawtext

principles.principle: Burned-in captions alone must carry the message.
principles.detail: Most impressions start muted. If the reel fails without audio, it fails.

principles.principle: Respect Instagram chrome: top ~250px and bottom ~420px are hostile.
principles.detail: Presenter layout: hookY 400, captionY 1290, ctaY 1400. Product shots move captions to top band with opaque navy box.

principles.principle: First frame understood in under 1.0 second; ≤8 words.
principles.detail: Concrete Hinglish decision moment beats cosmic abstraction. Dead if it could belong to any astrology app.

principles.principle: Show the live report hour-grid — never pricing or checkout.
principles.detail: Screencap is the honesty shot. Fake model-rendered UI is forbidden.

principles.principle: Presenter lines use in-shot native voice; never a second TTS timbre on that face.
principles.detail: Voice switch is the fastest Uncanny Valley. Connective VO on non-presenter shots uses one approved Sarvam ad voice only.

principles.principle: One recurring face recipe — same person, clothes, light — across all presenter shots.
principles.detail: Each fal shot is independent; under-described people get re-cast. Always pass the same reference still.

principles.principle: Default to Remotion/ffmpeg templates; generative video is a scarce cell, not the whole reel.
principles.detail: End cards, gradients, type, karaoke, wordmark are code. fal.ai is for locked presenter/b-roll only. Consistency is the premium signal.
principles.source: Cost + brand-memory analysis vs one-off Veo/Sora aesthetics; budget.ts caps

principles.principle: No paid render without a filled 12-slot storyboard.
principles.detail: S01–S12 in storyboardTemplate must be completed (optional slots may skip with reason). Prevents prompt-and-pray one-offs.
principles.source: This craft spec — founder-only approval operating model

principles.principle: End card invites to free Kundli + vedichour.com like a report signature — not an ad bumper.
principles.detail: No countdown, no fake scarcity, no coupon hero. Tagline optional whisper. UTM lives in caption/bio.
principles.source: Playbook end-card SOP + brand tagline rules

principles.principle: Reject cheap astrology AI tropes on sight.
principles.detail: No deities, zodiac wheels, purple nebulas, temple spam, plastic faces, gibberish screens, fear hooks. Calm fintech-meets-Jyotish only.

principles.principle: Music beds must not sound like royalty-free India pack spam.
principles.detail: 3–5 owned loops, sparse, ducked under VO. Avoid CapCut mystic/folk presets everyone recognizes.

principles.principle: Automation prepares; only the founder ships.
principles.detail: Queue via approvals. No auto-publish. Rejects feed lessons; never silently retry uncanny faces into production.
